capabilities: Insert emojis by typing trigger characters like ::smile
Search emojis with fuzzy matching and regular expressions
Add remote or local OWO-format emoji packs
Customize insertion templates and CSS styles
Select multiple emojis in the panel with multi-select mode
extras: Emoji packs are loaded from external sources such as emoticons.hzchu.top; the plugin caches them after first load.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to insert custom emoji packs or style how emojis are inserted into notes.
summary: Emoji insertion plugin that inserts custom emojis via trigger characters, a searchable panel, and OWO-format emoji packs with customizable templates.
